Prefix the instruction with the rank, 13px cream: 'Play next: Le Nette' and demote 'First: hearth or reach an inn.' to 11px #A89880 under it.

STATE / BONUS is an 11px mystery label. Rename the column header to 'REST' and show the five moons at 14px with 4px gaps; at 12px the partial moons cannot be counted.
Add a one-line legend under the list, 11px: green FULL, yellow 90%+, orange RESTING, red NOT RESTING, using the same chip fills (#1B5C34, #3A4210, #5A3412, #6E2222).
character_identity: Roster names are all cream, so Le Nette / Le Dette / Le jette blur. Class-color every row name at 14px (mage #69CCF0, hunter #ABD473, and so on) and fix 'Le jette' to 'Le Jette'.
Card title 'Colonol Sunders' is gold plaque text; color it hunter green #ABD473 and put race/class in the subtitle you already use on Le Nette.
Anchor the 'z z z' to the portrait: 11px #C8BBA0, 4px under the ring, not floating in the empty right margin. Bump row portraits from ~24px to 32px.

Section labels ('NOW PLAYING', 'STATE / BONUS', 'GETTING STARTED') at 11px #8A7A62, 8px above their block, tracking +1px, so cream stays on names and the #1 only.
Rank discs: #1 at 22px gold #C6A15B; rows 2-8 at 16px #3A3128 with 11px #E6D5A8 numerals. The current discs compete with the FULL chip.
elvui_wc3_fit: Kill the solid gold title plaque. Match Guild/Options: 22px bar #100C09, title 13px #E6D5A8 centered, 1px border #2A241C, 4px bronze studs #8A6A3E at the four corners. No filled gold band.

alerts_ux: The logout panel stacks under the countdown and reads as a second dialog. Dock a 420px banner 16px above the action bar, full width of the toast, not center-screen.

Color only the words '4x slower' in #E08A3C and keep the rest #F3E6C8. Lead the toast with the name already used on the banner: 'Jacques Hammer is not resting.'
readability: Comparison line 'Full for 2d · Le Beouf full for 8h' is 12px on the painting and fails. Set it 13px #E6D5A8 on a #16110C chip, 8px under 'levels banked'.
Row meta 'Lv 19 · Thunder Bluff · 3d ago' at low grey on #211B14 is the scan line players actually need. Raise it to 12px #C9BBA4; keep the percent at 13px #F4E8C8.
Chart gutter labels 0/50/100 are tiny and the plot is an empty black well. Use 11px #E6D5A8, add 1px gridlines #3A3128 at 50 and 100, and a 12px caption inside the plot when the series is flat.
layout_polish: ElvUI footer is two controls fighting one row. Footer height 28px: checkbox left, 12px gap, Compact only in the title. Do not move buttons between themes.

Card header has a dead zone right of the ring where 'z z z' sits. Fix the top band to 148px: bubble 12px left of the ring, tail on the ring edge, meta stacked under the name with 4px leading, no loose glyphs.

The 48h chart well is ~90% empty black, so it looks unloaded. Cap the chart height at 72px, baseline at 1px #6B5344, labels in a 36px right gutter, and hide the well entirely when the summary is 'Full the whole time'.
delight: The bubble is a flat #1C1914 rect. Give it a 10px radius, 1px #6B5344 edge, and a 8px baked tail that actually touches the ring; offset the card bubble 12px but keep a 2px gap so it never covers the level badge.
One speech line, not three facts: hero bubble 'Send me. Water's conjured.' and leave '1.7 levels banked' to the big figure only.
Empty and max-level rows get no voice. Give Le jette a 12px muted line 'Max level. I keep the bench warm.' and a single 400ms gold ring only when a chip flips to FULL.

overall_notes: The decision path is real: #1, a banked-XP figure, labeled state chips and a sorted roster. It is not yet a sibling of this user's UI. Default and ElvUI still share one ornate dashboard; his Guild, Character and Options windows are flat near-black, thin borders, quiet gold type, blue secondary and red only for close. The gold title plaque, footer-trapped Compact, floating z's, a blank 48h well, and a center-screen logout card are the amateur tells. Say the number once, class-color every name, and skin the chrome exactly like Options.
